raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 was delivered twice (at 02:00 and 05:00 on 2026-01-19) with identical rows, and batch 14 has 666 rows against a normal ~350. The silver step does not deduplicate on txn_id, so the duplicated transactions are counted twice and inflate 2026-01-18 volume. Keeping one row per txn_id, using the latest delivery, removes the duplicates without changing the schema.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.7, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT *, row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts DESC, batch_id DESC) AS rn FROM raw_transactions) r WHERE rn = 1 AND status = 'POSTED';"}}
